title: Enveda - CASMI 2026 Blind Molecular Identification Challenge
description: Blind de novo identification and candidate ranking of small molecules from tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Combines 1D spectra peak profiles with 2D/3D chemical graphs. Severe risk of chemical analog leakage across Bemis-Murcko scaffolds.
data_summary: Columnar tandem mass spectra (MS2) in Parquet format with precursor m/z, retention time, adduct states, and candidate SMILES chemical libraries exceeding 100,000 compounds.
